text: Convoy of Hope is a faith-based humanitarian organisation founded in 1994 by Hal Donaldson; it is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit organisation with no shareholders.
short: Convoy of Hope is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit humanitarian organisation.

source.name: Convoy of Hope: About (European site)
source.quote: Convoy of Hope is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organisation. All donations are tax-deductible where allowed by law.
source.note: Footer statement on the About page, which also states Convoy of Hope was founded in 1994 by Hal Donaldson. Cited from convoyofhope.eu: convoyofhope.org blocks scripts (403). Page has no date; opened 2026-10-03.
